description: This file implements a DualCache class that updates both Redis and in-memory caches simultaneously, providing methods for setting, getting, incrementing, batch operations, and cache management. It is part of a caching system within a larger project.

classes.name: LimitedSizeOrderedDict
classes.description: A subclass of OrderedDict that limits its size by removing the oldest item when a new item exceeds the maximum size.

classes.name: DualCache
classes.description: A cache class that updates both Redis and in-memory caches simultaneously, with methods for cache management, retrieval, and batch operations.

methods.name: update_cache_ttl
methods.description: Updates default TTL values for in-memory and Redis caches.

methods.name: set_cache
methods.description: Sets a cache value in both Redis and in-memory caches, with optional TTL.

methods.name: increment_cache
methods.description: Increments a cache value in both caches and returns the new value.

methods.name: get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves a cache value, checking in-memory first, then Redis if not found.

methods.name: batch_get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache values, handling event loop considerations.

methods.name: async_get_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a cache value, checking in-memory first, then Redis.

methods.name: get_redis_batch_keys
methods.description: Determines which keys need to be fetched from Redis based on last access time and expiry.

methods.name: async_batch_get_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves multiple cache values with Redis fallback and batch handling.

methods.name: async_set_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a cache value in both caches.

methods.name: async_set_cache_pipeline
methods.description: Batch asynchronously sets multiple cache values.

methods.name: async_increment_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously increments a cache value in both caches.

methods.name: async_increment_cache_pipeline
methods.description: Batch asynchronously increments multiple cache values.

methods.name: async_set_cache_sadd
methods.description: Adds a value to a set in both caches asynchronously.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Clears both in-memory and Redis caches.

methods.name: delete_cache
methods.description: Deletes a key from both caches.

methods.name: async_delete_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a key from both caches.

methods.name: async_get_ttl
methods.description: Retrieves the TTL of a key from in-memory cache or Redis.
